summary: Completed comprehensive testing of White-Label Branding feature. All backend API endpoints (GET/PUT /api/branding, POST/DELETE /api/branding/logo) working correctly. Frontend branding dialog opens, live preview updates in real-time, color presets work, Powered By toggle shows text input when enabled, and changes persist to MongoDB. Header dynamically updates after saving branding. Regression tests confirm dashboard, reviews, analytics, and integrations still work.
